variants.headline: Party walks out of government
variants.body: The party {party} has walked out of the government. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: A governing partnership breaks
variants.body: The government has lost the party {party} from its governing arrangement. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Departure redraws the question of cooperation
variants.body: The party {party} has left the colony's government. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.
